turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Aao Kavita, kaisi ho? Kitne mahine ho gaye?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Doctor 24 hafte ho gaye. 1 hafte se pairon mein thodi sujan hai, shaam ko zyada hoti hai.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Baby ki movement theek mehsoos ho rahi hai?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Haan, din bhar hilta rehta hai.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Good. BP 124 by 80 hai, normal hai. Weight 63 kg. Hemoglobin thoda kam hai, 9.8, matlab mild anaemia hai. Pairon ki sujan is stage mein normal hai, pair upar rakh ke so.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Doctor kamar mein bahut dard hota hai, Brufen le loon kya?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Nahi, pregnancy mein Brufen bilkul nahi lena. Halki exercise aur garam paani ki sikai karo.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Theek hai. Kisi dawai se allergy nahi hai mujhe.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Iron ki goli, Ferrous ascorbate 100 mg, din mein ek baar lunch ke baad, poori pregnancy chalegi. Calcium 500 mg subah-shaam, wo bhi continue. Iron aur calcium saath mein mat lena, gap rakhna.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Agar bleeding ho, baby ki movement kam lage, ya bahut tez sir dard aur dhundla dikhe, toh usi waqt hospital aana.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: 4 hafte baad, sugar wala glucose test karwa ke aana.

trap: Patient asks for Brufen, refused in pregnancy.
